scope: Reachability of the conditional MusicPlayer creation branch for the locally available AppWorld train/dev tasks whose frozen ground-truth traces call show_current_song or show_song_queue. Task databases are reconstructed in memory.
interpretation_boundary: Zero users without a MusicPlayer makes the create-and-save branch unreachable for authenticated users in these reconstructed initial task states. It does not prove the branch is unreachable for arbitrary or future AppWorld databases.
